07629 Shobiy {sho-bee'}

源自 07617; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Shobi 1; 1

朔比 = "榮耀的"
1) 亞捫後裔拉巴人拿轄的兒子; 於押沙龍叛變時支持接待了大衛王 (#撒下 17:27|)

07629 Shobiy {sho-bee'}

from 07617;; n pr m

AV - Shobi 1; 1

Shobi = "glorious"
1) son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon; supported David
   during Absalom's rebellion
